title: Cheap, save space, but thin plastic. Returned
text:
Cheap, save space, but thin plastic. Returned. I like how you can stack them to save space. However, I returned it because of the cheap plastic.

Three stars because they are good for once a while baking session, but not for me as I intend to use it daily.

product_metadata.title: NPYPQ 3 Piece Measuring Cup Set, Includes 1-Cup, 2-Cup, and 4-Cup Clear Plastic Liquid Measuring Cups Easy to Read, Essential Kitchen Tools
features: Universal Measurements Version - Measuring cups set includes 1-cup, 2-cup and 4-cup versions.
Easy-to-Read - in high-contrast measurements in metric, oz and usa cup units, offers precise scales and bright visual.
Food-Grade - Made of high impact food safe plastic material, clear plastic for easy viewing.
Easy Grip and Stackable Design - Large, sturdy handle. measure cups handle adopts unique plug-in nesting design to save kitchen space.
Easy to Clean - Not dishwasher safe Hand wash is fine and BPA-Free . ideal for use every day to measure liquids, solid ingredients in cooking and baking.
